experimental_design: proteomic characterization of the LAMP fraction

We performed proteomic analysis to reveal lipoproteins, elongation factors, chaperones and chaperonins, and cytadherence proteins (previously found to induce strong antibody responses) as the most abundant immunogenic and antigenic components of the LAMP fraction
number_of_samples: Purified LAMPs were prepared using a slightly modified filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) method
